LESSON 39 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
Language and text direction

The lang attribute identifies content language for assistive technology and other processing. dir sets
text direction; dir="auto" lets the browser infer it from content.
lang attribute එJකෙන් content language එකෙ කියෙනවා. dir attribute එJකෙන් text direction එකෙ කියෙනවා. Multilingual website එකෙකෙට Jම් Jදෙකෙ වුදෙගත්.
A multilingual website contains English and right-to-left content.

Read the diagram: Language and direction are separate properties. A screen reader can select an
appropriate pronunciation language, and layout respects the chosen base direction.
Expected result: The page identifies English as its default language and Sinhala for the paragraph.
Interview question: Why set lang on the html element?
Answer: It tells assistive technology and other processors the document language.
